name: cognigy
description: NiCE Cognigy Plugin — create, test, and manage AI Agents on the NiCE Cognigy platform

cognigy_api_base_url.title: Cognigy API base URL
cognigy_api_base_url.description: Your Cognigy instance API URL. Leave blank to use a saved profile or the credentials file. If you are on the trial, enter https://api-trial.cognigy.ai.

cognigy_api_key.title: Cognigy API key
cognigy_api_key.description: Find it in Cognigy.AI → User Menu → My Profile → API Keys.

cognigy_profile.title: Default Cognigy profile
cognigy_profile.description: Profile name to lock each session to (e.g. edj). Leave empty for none. `csp -p` / COGNIGY_ENVIRONMENT overrides it.
